failure_mechanism: STOP_TOO_WIDE_RELATIVE_TO_TARGET / a diffuse mix of DIRECTIONAL_FAILURE and TARGET_NOT_REACHED_DESPITE_POSITIVE_MFE concentrated in the widest-stop setups -- see data/stabilization/phase7/postmortem/diagnostic_buckets.json -> stop_distance_in_atr_quintiles.
single_change: Add one new pre-entry eligibility condition: reject a setup if stop_distance_atr > 3.975 (the empirical Q4/Q5 cutpoint on the full consumed distribution). Entry, stop, and target price levels themselves are computed exactly as the frozen parent engine already computes them -- this only decides whether to ACT on a setup the engine already produced, never how the setup is constructed.
causal_rationale: stop_distance_atr is a decision-time-observable ratio of the engine's own selected stop distance to the prevailing 14-period M5 ATR. An unusually wide stop relative to current volatility plausibly indicates either (a) a less precise/lower-quality structural pullback where the protected swing sits unusually far from the retracement entry, or (b) an entry taken further into an already-extended move than the typical setup. Either mechanism is consistent with the observed pattern: the widest-stop quintile is the only quintile whose grouped 95% CI excludes zero on the negative side (mean -0.327R, CI [-0.480, -0.146]), while the tightest-stop quintile is the best-performing bucket (+0.175R, CI still crossing zero). This is a plausible market/execution-geometry mechanism, not a fit to noise: it uses only information the engine already computes before entry.
overfitting_risk: LOW-MODERATE. The cutpoint is a plain quartile boundary of the full consumed distribution (not searched/optimized against the outcome), and the excluded bucket's CI is the only one of five that excludes zero, so the signal is not an artifact of one especially favorable bin among many tried. Residual risk: the cutpoint was still chosen after observing which quintile happened to look worst, which is why this remains a hypothesis requiring untouched-history confirmation, not a validated result.
falsification_condition: On genuinely untouched history, the retained (stop_distance_atr <= 3.975) population fails to show conservative-cost expectancy greater than zero with a grouped lower-95 confidence bound greater than zero, OR fails to beat the unfiltered parent's expectancy with a grouped lower-95 bound greater than zero.
